title: Loot Rewind
body:
# Loot Rewind

Loot Rewind lets you undo unwanted item pickups with a simple Ctrl+Z-style shortcut.

Picked up rotten flesh, cobblestone, seeds, or other junk by accident? Press the undo shortcut and the latest picked-up item is dropped back into the world.

## Features

*   Undo recent item pickups one at a time
*   Default shortcut: `Ctrl + Z`
*   Client-side and lightweight
*   No config screen, no extra menus, no setup

## Keybinds

You can change everything under `Options > Controls > Key Binds > Loot Rewind`.

*   `Undo last pickup`: the main undo key
*   `Hold for undo`: the modifier key

Want to use just one key without Ctrl? Unbind `Hold for undo`.

## Notes

Loot Rewind is made for accidental pickups. It does not undo chest transfers, crafting, trading, or other inventory actions.
